entities.summary: The Treaty of Königsberg was a treaty during Lithuanian Civil War (1381–1384) signed between Vytautas the Great and representatives of the Teutonic Knights. It was signed in Königsberg on 30 January 1384. Vytautas granted territory to the Teutonic Knights in return for their support in the civil war.
